sandwich noun

also ham sandwich

modern

Traupman 73

pastillum fartum

Other words

  • pastillum pernā fartum — ham sandwich

    also used · modern · Traupman 325

  • pānis fartus (replētus)

    also used · modern · M-O

    M-O prefers it, noting that pastillum, a little loaf, is found only in two grammarians (Varro ap. Charis.; Paul. ex Fest.).

Examples

  • Vīsne pastillum pernā fartum?

    Do you want a ham sandwich?composed

See also ham, stuffing.

SourcesLewis & Short: pastillum · Lewis & Short: farcio

Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. sandwich.

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 73, 325.

The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
